result_preview.title: Customer Order Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages customer orders and account details for order processing
result_preview.description: Exposes customer account information and order data to enable real-time order retrieval, modification, and status tracking. Provides access to customer account hierarchies, order histories, and line-item details for downstream sales and customer service operations. Manages customer order lifecycle events including creation, amendment, and fulfillment coordination.

result_preview.title: Customer Account Order Enrichment API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages integrated customer account and order data for engagement targeting.
result_preview.description: Exposes comprehensive customer account profiles and order history to enable precise segmentation and personalized journey orchestration. Provides access to real-time account attributes and transactional order data, allowing marketing systems to retrieve enriched customer context for campaign personalization and lifecycle engagement strategies.
useCases: Sales operations contextualize orders with prior purchase patterns and account status.
Customer service teams reduce fulfillment errors by confirming shipping addresses and preferences.
Revenue teams identify upsell opportunities within enriched order context.
Sales operations team ensures all customer systems reflect new product SKUs, pricing tiers, and promotional bundles.
Sales enablement team publishes new product to customer accounts and processes initial orders

Order management system validates customer orders against enriched product and pricing catalogs.
Customer success team enriches account records with product launch eligibility and cross-sell opportunities.
Customer service representative adds new product to account offerings and upsell recommendations

result_preview.title: Customer Order Fulfillment Tracking API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages customer order status, fulfillment milestones, and delivery tracking data.
result_preview.description: This API exposes real-time customer order fulfillment data, enabling applications to retrieve order details, track shipment progress, and manage delivery status updates. It provides access to comprehensive order lifecycle information across customer accounts, supporting both order status queries and fulfillment event management for seamless customer service operations.
useCases: Sales team receives a new customer order and confirms it can be fulfilled based on account standing and delivery capability.
Order fulfillment process begins by validating customer eligibility and order specifications.
